tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled (unchanged through 1.0.1 — re-verified against rtk master src/hooks/rewrite_cmd.rs, which still renders Allow→0, Deny→2, Ask→3, Default→3, Defer→1 with the #1155 least-privilege tests intact). Since 0.49.0: -l is GNU --files-with-matches under rtk grep (completing 0.47.0's -t/-m passthrough), rewrite handles safe pipes, peels process wrapper prefixes, and passes sudo commands through. Since 0.50.0: head/tail rewrites are faithful to the native commands (head window no longer reads past the lines requested, non-UTF-8 windows preserved), git/grep/dotnet/golangci arg parsing migrated onto a shared arg_tokenizer, and rtk gain reports weighted savings rates with signed saved-token sums (negative totals are possible; the metrics.ts negative-delta/clawback branch already handles them). The new rtk ast-grep output filter is search-shaped like rtk grep and stays pass-through — it is not in the blocked cat/read/smart code-reading family. 1.0.0 (the 1.x milestone: pipelines in the CLI, hook gate, rtk llm-proxy; engine/plugin/text crate split; rtk-proxy daemon) breaks per its own BREAKING CHANGES block: rtk proxy is now rtk bypass (old name stays an alias), --ultra-compact is removed, rtk gain excludes oversized outputs from its headline rate, and the default binary's licence changes (an Apache-2.0 rtk-oss edition ships alongside) — none of the renamed/removed surfaces are in rig's call surface (no rtk proxy/rtk bypass/--ultra-compact anywhere in src/, templates/, or tests/). The in-process `rtk hook <agent>` path still exists in 1.x, so the rtk-global-hook marker (\brtk hook\b in ~/.claude/settings.json) still detects a 1.x `rtk init -g`. 1.0.1 fixes gain only suggesting `rtk pipeline share` where the command exists (#4557) and llm-proxy honouring RTK_PROXY_BIND (#4556) — rig consumes neither. metrics.ts parses only summary.total_saved from `rtk gain --format json` and warns on schema drift, so the headline-rate semantics change is display-side; re-check the JSON shape against a real 1.0.1 binary in the local-verification step (the contract test self-skips where no rtk binary exists).

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.53 writes no .rebuild.lock; its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json, and since 0.9.53 (#3203) an unverified per-source shrink arms the guard and re-queues the source on the next run — a first run can legitimately return a smaller graph that a later run completes. Since 0.9.65 (#3697/#3695) the eviction pass re-checks the kept set, so a moved-file/symlink layout can no longer deadlock the shrink guard into refusing every update. Since 0.9.66 graph.json is deterministic across runs (PYTHONHASHSEED pinned via a one-time re-exec; the re-exec exit-code races that path introduced were fixed through 0.9.67/0.9.68), and 0.9.68 preserves cross-file imports/calls/uses edges into unchanged files on incremental updates (node/edge counts shift upward on multilingual repos — a /savings display change, not a parse change). 0.9.70 ships security fixes — GHSA-pcc4-rvhr-2pr8 (the Fortran cpp step no longer reads arbitrary host files via absolute/traversing #include during preprocessing; contents could previously be inlined into graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md and the LLM context), --watch snippet shell injection closed, Terraform secret redaction widened — plus five new language extractors in 0.9.66 (COBOL, VB.NET, R, Solidity, Erlang). 0.9.92 lands twenty-three community PRs — call-resolution and id-collision fixes across JS/TS, Python, Go, Rust and Solidity; graph round-trip, dedup and confidence-folding fixes; skill code-only-update and dispatch fixes; LLM/Ollama and detection fixes. Its AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts — expect one slower first `graphify update` per repo (session-start's 5s post-update poll for graph.json just waits it out; timing behavior otherwise unchanged). MCP parallel edges are preserved through the graph.json round-trip and query output (#4500/#4503) — the scout's direct graph.json parse and god-node degrees can show higher edge counts, a display-side change like 0.9.68's; model-drifted string confidences fold to a valid value before validation and dedup (#4495/#4501), feeding the same EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS fields session start renders as percentages; a node with a source_file beats a sourceless namesake in collision rank (#4492/#4496); only a valid `.git` is treated as a VCS root (#4444/#4464). New git hooks: post-merge rebuilds on real merges and a new post-rewrite hook rebuilds after cherry-pick/rebase/`pull --rebase` (#4463/#4476; #4490/#4491) — these overlap rig's own auto-build triggers, both may fire, benign duplication. tree-sitter-dm is capped <0.26 so a fresh install cannot pull the ABI-incompatible 0.26 grammar (#4044). The GRAPH_REPORT.md summary/extraction layout that metrics.ts regex-matches was unchanged through 0.9.71; 0.9.92's notes list no layout change — re-verify the regexes against a real 0.9.92 report in the local-verification step (metrics.ts warns on parse drift; no graphify binary exists in the implement sandbox).

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`. Since 0.38.0: zip-bomb DoS bound and per-port proxy logs. 0.39.0 reworked the savings surface (new-input basis beside whole-wire, exact cache-read cost in rollups, lifetime output spend, negative savings reported instead of floored at zero) and added protect_messages plus TPM limiting; captureHeadroomStats gates on finite numbers, so signed tokens_saved passes and renders. 0.39.1 fixes 0.39.0's TPM limiter refusing large-context requests — never pin 0.39.0. Since 0.40.0: usage reporting is opt-in and governed by HEADROOM_LICENSE (#3857) and the crewai extra is dropped (#3870) — neither surface is consumed by rig (detection reads the init hook marker / localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads only `headroom perf`), but operators now see opt-in telemetry prompts. Savings metrics got one canonical home (0.40.0 #3320), native Rust-proxy spend/savings stats plus a dashboard (0.41.0 #2321), per-agent attribution in history checkpoints and rollups (0.41.0 #2627), and the headline-number holdout fix (#3127). captureHeadroomStats reads the four flat fields (tokens_saved/total_requests/savings_pct/cache_hit_pct) and warns on schema drift instead of failing, so nested or renamed per-agent fields degrade to a warning, never a break — re-check the flat shape on the next bump. Pin 0.41.0 (current latest).

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill. 7.0.0 rebuilt brainstorming (#2463): it sizes the work after understanding it (quick task done at once / small change agreed in chat / written design with a builder check), its first message offers to skip the questions, and a builder-check subagent replaces the spec-document reviewer — the brain+ overlay applies in full on every path including the skip-the-questions path, and the loop-fit opt-in composes with owns-the-choices (#2482/#2483). Since 6.4.2 (#2333) plans record decisions, not transcripts (What a Step Contains + proportion self-review); plan+ task lines stay decision-level. 7.0.0 carries the Spec: pointer (#2086), the Review Focus section (#2319), and the two-way plan handoff (#2258/#2318, in writing-plans' Execution Handoff) natively — rig's pins are native-confirmed: plan+ adds the one-line scope summary and the explicit Spec:none fallback, sdd+ answers the handoff Subagent-driven (tdd+ is the native/inline peer) and stays stricter than 7.0.0's provisional spec-less rulings by stopping to ask. 7.0.1 retunes brainstorming (#2560/#2571): it digs into the project's own context before its first question and never asks what the context already answers; questions build on answers and say what the answer would change; the skip-the-questions offer is now conditional — it appears only when brainstorming started on its own, so by-name invocation (the /brain+ path, which dispatches the skill by name) never sees it; and after understanding it lays out two or three approaches with a recommendation for the user to pick, then writes the design doc (short or full) carrying an Approaches part that gates all building until approved — builder check retained. 7.0.1 also restructures subagent-driven-development for compaction survival (#2565): its fix-loop, final-review, report-handling, resuming, preflight, batching, and cannot-verify guidance moved into references/ files read from disk at the step that needs them (same content, restructured; upstream caps SKILL.md under 20,000 bytes); writing-skills and executing-plans were trimmed the same way, and neither is wrapped by rig. Deliberate divergences that stand against 7.0.0 and 7.0.1 alike: SDD task-batching (#2078, still offered upstream in 7.0.1 via references/batching.md) is declined in sdd+ — per-task dispatch is load-bearing; the TDD full-suite-during-the-loop rule (#2110, sharpened in 7.0.0 to 'a scope statement in your task bounds the deliverable, not your verification') is declined for the tdd+/sdd+ loop — the full-suite green gate stays in verify+ where the zero-defect hook blocks (divergence documented in the tdd+ template). Plan handoff (#2258/#2318) unchanged through 7.0.1.
